description: Bitcoin only, beta. The BTC derivatives market: funding, open interest, liquidations, long/short, taker volume, ETF flows, options max pain and a fear and greed index (0 to 100, 100 = extreme greed), each with its own observed time and cadence. Open interest comes for one contract (`instrument`, its venue in `exchange`) and for several together: `contracts` lists the perpetual contracts in that one figure, `contracts_unlisted` counts any leg it does not name, and `includes_single_contract` says whether the one contract is among them; a venue not shown here is null. `flow.retail` is the all-accounts long/short ratio (the global account ratio, by number of accounts), set against the top-trader position ratio. A pending ETF day has a null flow, never 0, whatever TSP's own word for it (tsp_status: reported, provisional or null). Clock verdicts (cadence_check, open_bucket.closed, stopped_refreshing, max pain's nearest expiry) are judged at the moment of the answer. By default the latest reading of every metric is complete and the back-history beside it is the newest 3 points per series; the answer's `history` block reports how many older points were left out. Set `history` to true for the full stored series. Not investment advice.

history.description: True returns every stored point of each series instead of the newest 3. The answer is about twice as large.
